section_summary.extract_value: This section reports modifications to confirmatory factor analyses for the CEMS and IES-2: specific items were removed and an error covariance added for CEMS, and several IES-2 items were excluded, with the IES-2 retained as four first-order factors. It notes that after these adjustments the models achieved adequate fit for the total sample and for gender subsamples (women and men), and refers to Table 2 for fit indices.
section_summary.evidence_source: "Table 2 reports the indices used to assess the fit of the CEMS and IES-2 models in our data." "For the CEMS with the total sample, one error covariance was added between items one and two... and the elimination of item ten..." "In the case of the IES-2, items 1, 13, and 15 consistently showed poor factors loading and the item four showed high residuals, therefore, these items were excluded... the IES-2 showed adequate fit in the total sample, as well as for women and men (see Table 2)."
